281503071.description: This polished six-sided obelisk tower is made from pink tourmaline in granite. The stone features distinctive banded patterns in pink, white, gray, and brown hues. The tower measures 5.25 tall with a base dimension of approximately 1.25 by 1.75. The piece weighs 371.9 grams as measured on a digital scale. It has a pointed tip and a slight wobble when placed on a flat surface. The crystal is in good condition with no visible chips or cracks. Suitable for collectors or display purposes.

281638052.description:
Natural Polished Geode Half with White Crystalline Interior Mineral Specimen
This natural mineral specimen is a geode half with a hollow interior cavity. The exterior surface is rough and brown, while the interior features a polished, crystalline white to translucent surface with intricate formations. The geode has been cut and partially polished to showcase the sparkling crystal structures inside. The piece shows typical characteristics of natural minerals, including minor imperfections and rough edges. It is in used/displayed condition with no significant damage visible.
5 x 5 x 4 in
